That charge looks like a likely subscription renewal for urlWalmart+https://www.walmart.com/plus, Walmart’s membership program.

A few clues:
- “WALMART+ MEMBER”
- Amount is $14.18, which lines up closely with the monthly Walmart+ fee after tax in many states
- “WALMART.COM AR” = Walmart online billing through Arkansas processing
- Merchant category “Direct Marketing” is common for subscription billing

What Walmart+ includes:
- Free delivery/shipping
- Paramount+ streaming
- Gas discounts
- Scan & Go in stores

If you truly don’t recognize it:
1. Check if you, an ex-spouse, family member, or someone on your Walmart account signed up for a free trial that converted.
2. Search your email for:
   - “Walmart+”
   - “membership renewal”
   - “Walmart.com”
3. Log into:
   - urlWalmart Account Membership Pagehttps://www.walmart.com/plus/account
4. Check Apple Pay/Google Pay subscriptions too if you used mobile checkout.

If it’s unauthorized:
- Contact Walmart support immediately:
  - urlWalmart Customer Servicehttps://www.walmart.com/help
- Then dispute with your bank/card issuer if needed.

One thing to note: the amount being odd ($14.18 instead of a flat number) strongly suggests a real taxed subscription renewal rather than random fraud.
